## Card report

Use [dashcamigo.app/add-my-camera](https://dashcamigo.app/add-my-camera) to
create a report from the card, then attach it here. The report contains file and
folder names, not your recordings.

If you already know how the camera stores GPS data, tell us here. A screenshot
or short example of the card's folder layout can also help.

## Sample recording

Reliable support needs a real sample from the camera; formats often differ
between models and firmware versions.

**Please do not attach a recording publicly unless you are comfortable sharing
where and when it was made. GitHub attachments may remain accessible even after
an issue is edited or deleted.** To share it privately, email the files or a
download link to **feedback@dashcamigo.app** and include a link to this issue.

A useful sample contains:

- a few original clips copied directly from the SD card;
- every camera recorded at the same time, such as front and rear;
- the neighboring GPS or log files, with the original names and folder layout;
- no trimming, conversion or re-encoding.

If the camera can show coordinates or speed on the video, turn that option on.
It gives us a reference for checking the result.

By sharing a sample, you confirm that it is yours to share and may be used to
build and test camera support. The original recording is never committed to the
repository: published fixtures have rounded coordinates and replacement video.
